fact: The DGI's e-services portal FAQ of April 2025 says taxpayers file returns (télédéclaration) and pay taxes (télépaiement by ePayment from a registered bank account, mobile web payment, or at the counter) online, and that the portal aims to dematerialise all returns and payments with no parallel paper return.
title: Portail e-services Bénin - Questions fréquentes (FAQ)
publisher: Direction Générale des Impôts, République du Bénin
